site.method: Imagery-verified EIA-860M plant 68902 'Echols Creek Solar' (entity BT Ferguson Solar, LLC) point, corroborated by independent Google Places business pin 'Echols Grove Solar' at 3018 U.S. Hwy 271 S, Paris TX 75462 (33.611368,-95.445060, 1.35 km away). Re-checked the two candidate PUCT map_artifacts below: p43 is a one-line electrical diagram (project name/GINR/MW only, no georeference) and Amendment Exhibit C p7's POI-location paragraph is CEII-REDACTED in the filed text — neither is an actual geo-referenced map, so the site does NOT reach the map-exhibit or IA-Exhibit-C-text provenance rungs. Rung achieved: imagery-verified EIA. 5x Sentinel-2 dates (2024-07 → 2026-07, s2aws.py) at this anchor (3.5–4.5km buffer) show a new access-road/civil-grading footprint appearing between 2025-07 and 2025-11, centered ~2.6 km SE of the EIA point (approx. 33.598,-95.441) — a plausible offset for a single reported plant centroid vs. a >1,200-acre multi-parcel array. Confirmed NOT a neighbor-plant misattribution: nearest operating solar (Eiffel Solar, 240MW) is 6.5km W, Chisum (10MW) is 6.5km NE, Rowdy Creek Solar 24INR0186 (the other Lamar County queue project) is 23km N — none coincide with the observed construction footprint, and neither pre-existing operating neighbor shows any change across the imagery series.

No PV panel rows/racking visible yet. Not under construction' carried through the May 2026 snapshot — EIA status field reads as stale/self-reported, the same pattern already seen in the EIA-vs-queue COD divergence. Civil-grading pace is consistent with the Amendment No.1 schedule (NTP due 2025-12-09, In-Service 2026-12-03).
